info.title: prx — verb surface
info.description: OpenAPI projection of the prx VerbSpec registry (verbspec's HTTP surface). Generated from the Zod verb specs — edit the verbs, not this file.

post.summary: List the tool actors for a scope (pr / workflow), as text or JSON.
Read the contract trinity (--list / --kind / id), or apply the pr-contract skill event.
Render (or --check) the generated docs: jsonld, readme, community, cli, claude-context.
Apply a pr-skill's lifecycle event to the contract (advancing the state or recording a blocked transition).
Render (or --check) every generated gherkin .feature from its source of truth.
Kick off and supervise many pilots — the agents view.
Emit the prx state-machine graph in a chosen format (xstate / mermaid / json).
Report code sprawl, coupling, dead code, and spec-driven-CLI readiness.
Show the work-unit model (actors → raw facts → invariants → phase) for a scope.
Show a work unit's pilot telemetry timeline (legs + seams) from the audit log.
Derive the pr open mode (draft/ready) from the contract; emit as mode, JSON, or a gh command.
Show a repo's PR/worktree overview — by registered <slug> or the cwd / --repo-path.
Drive ONE work unit through the pipeline (plan → implement → CI → merge).
Close a plan-mode work unit's GH issue without merging, and mirror the close into beads.
Load a plan slot to stdout (raw body or json); falls back approved→draft when --slot is omitted.
Deterministic pre-draft preflight (already-done / infeasible-action / blocked-by-open-deps).
Persist a plan body (stdin or --from-file) to the CAS plan store; warns (not refuses) on shape misses.
Show a plan slot (head preview or full json), or --paths to report where plans land.
Show a PR's review-comment threads, or resolve them; exits 1 while any stay unresolved.
Reconcile main-branch protection (branch-protection or ruleset); `--check` reports drift and exits 1 when it doesn't match.
Report a PR's failing remote CI checks; exits 1 when any are failing.
List a repo branch's required status-check names; exits 1 when none resolve.
Render (or --check) every committed JSON-Schema artifact from its Zod source.
Summarize a PR's failing-check logs; exits 1 when any checks are failing.
List the pr skill catalog (events allowed from the contract's current state).
Copy the prx machine (xstate-ts) to the clipboard and open it in the Stately editor.
Show the PR contract's derived status (state/mode/reason) as a line, bare mode, or JSON.
Apply a lifecycle transition to the PR contract, log it, and report the new status.
Show the current worktree's PR-relevant status for a repo path.
List the repo's worktrees and their branch/PR status.
